name: Tsuchiura Miki
source: The school nurse who is the [url=/c82146]protagonist's[/url] partner-in-crime and consultant. Miki is the Director of the Hypnosis Development Institute and the one who taught the protagonist how hypnotism works. She is also in a sexual relationship with him.
